# PopNow for Blender

> PopNow for Blender is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0-or-later) Blender 4.2+ add-on that turns clay renders, camera views and camera animations into AI images, AI video and seamless textures using models hosted on PopNow (https://popnow.ai). It adds a PopNow tab to the 3D Viewport sidebar and pays in exact US dollars from the user's PopNow API balance, which is separate from website credits.

## Workflows

- Render with AI: grey clay render (camera, viewport or last F12 render) + optional depth / normal / line-art pass + up to three reference images -> finished image. Models: Seedream 5.0 Pro, Seedream 5.0 Flash, Nano Banana 2.1, GPT Image 2, Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo, FLUX.1 dev ControlNet.
- Animate with AI: Workbench preview of the camera animation -> MP4 that keeps the camera move and timing. Models: Seedance 2.0 Mini, Seedance 2.0 Fast, Seedance 2.0, Seedance 2.5, Wan 3.0, Kling O3 Restyle, Wan 2.2 Animate (motion transfer onto a character image).
- Texture: prompt -> square seamless texture and box-projected material. Models: Seedream 5.0 Flash, Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo, Seedream 5.0 Pro, Nano Banana 2.1.

## Install

- Build: `python3 scripts/build_zip.py` writes `dist/popnow-blender-<version>.zip` (or download it from https://popnow.ai/blender).
- Blender: Edit > Preferences > Get Extensions > menu > Install from Disk, or drag the zip into Blender. Allow online access.
- API key: https://popnow.ai/api/console/keys (keys start with `sk-popnow-`); paste it in the PopNow tab (N panel). The `POPNOW_API_KEY` environment variable is used when no key is saved.

## How it works

- Pure standard-library client in `popnow/core/client.py` against `https://api.popnow.ai/api/v1`.
- Upload: `POST /common/upload-url` -> PUT bytes -> `POST /files/{fileId}/commit` -> `popnow://f/...` URI.
- Price: `POST /jobs/quote` (`maxChargeUsd`), user confirms, then `POST /jobs/createTask` with `quoteId`, `expectedCostUsd` (the quote's `maxChargeUsd`) and `Idempotency-Key`.
- Result: poll `GET /jobs/recordInfo?taskId=...` until `succeeded` / `failed` / `expired`; download `output.assets[].url` without the key.
- Billing: exact USD decimal strings (`maxChargeUsd`, `estimatedCostUsd`, `costUsd`, `availableUsd`) handled with decimal.Decimal; the credit fields are deprecated fallbacks (1 credit = $0.001). No subscription; failed runs are not charged. Add funds: https://popnow.ai/api/console/billing. Prices: https://popnow.ai/api/pricing.

## Repository layout

- `popnow/`: the extension (manifest, `core/` without bpy, `ui/` Blender side, `licenses/`).
- `scripts/build_zip.py`, `scripts/sync_models.py`: packaging and model table refresh.
- `tests/`: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` (no Blender needed); `tests/blender_selftest.py` runs inside Blender.
